name: Polychem Limited
about: Polychem Limited, together with its subsidiary, manufactures and sells polymers and co-polymers in India, the United Kingdom, the United States, the Netherlands, Germany, Japan, and Hungary. The company operates through three segments: Specialty Chemicals; Property Development; and Manufacturing and Trading in Capacitors. It offers styrene, divinyl benzene, acrylic acid, and acrylates, as well as cross linked polystyrene, low molecular weight polystyrene, styrene ethyl acrylate co-polymer, and styrene butyl acrylate co-polymer. The company also manufactures, outsources, and markets ceramic capacitors. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
